Connects over SSH to the host and re-enables and starts the already-installed associate service. Use

Uploads the manager's current associate (and helper) binaries to the host and restarts the service. The
          host keeps its certificate and bundle — only the code changes. Use this after updating the manager, so
          hosts stop running the build they were enrolled with.

      

      

        

          
The associate restarts, so any job running on this host is interrupted. The host drops offline

Uploads this manager's associate (and helper) binaries to every host running older associate code, and
          restarts each service. Hosts keep their certificates and bundles — only the code changes.

      

      

        
Hosts already running the same associate code are skipped, even
          when the manager itself is newer: a manager update that changed only the dashboard or manager-side code
          leaves them alone.

        

          
Each associate restarts, so jobs running on those hosts are interrupted and the hosts drop
            offline for a few seconds while they reconnect.

        

        
Every host is tried first with the manager's SSH key or agent and
          its own stored SSH user — nothing to type here. Any host that comes back needing a login is asked about
          individually afterwards, so hosts with different credentials are handled one at a time.
